open_points.subject: _photo_moment contract
open_points.text: def _photo_moment(image: Image.Image, modified: datetime, zone: ZoneInfo) -> tuple[datetime, DateSource]
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: Either Image must be added to IMPORTS with an allowed Pillow import, or the contract must stop using Image.Image.

open_points.subject: _photo_moment
open_points.text: _photo_moment: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the EXIF of the first frame once with Image.getexif, take ExifTags.Base.DateTimeOriginal and ExifTags.Base.OffsetTimeOriginal from its ExifTags.IFD.Exif directory and ExifTags.Base.DateTime from its first directory, a reading that fails counting as no EXIF, and return the first moment _parse_exif_moment gives for DateTimeOriginal with OffsetTimeOriginal, then for DateTime with no offset, each read in zone and judged against modified, paired with the EXIF member of = models.DateSource; when neither gives one it MUST return modified unchanged with the FILE_MODIFIED member. It MUST NOT read the service clock.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: Either the required Pillow Image and ExifTags imports must be listed in IMPORTS, or this requirement must stop requiring those unavailable symbols.

open_points.subject: prepare_photo validation
open_points.text: prepare_photo: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST open raw with Image.open restricted to the formats of the imported SOURCE_FORMATS constant; a source is opened when Image.open returns and the width and height of its first frame are read, and any failure before that, a DecompressionBombError of Image.open included, MUST raise Rejected with the UNREADABLE_IMAGE member of = models.PlacementFailure; for an opened source, before decoding pixels, it MUST raise Rejected with TOO_MANY_PIXELS when that width times that height is above the imported MAX_PIXELS constant; a later failure to decode the first frame or of any operation of the first rule of A2 MUST raise Rejected with UNREADABLE_IMAGE, and an encoded result longer than the imported MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES constant Rejected with TOO_LARGE; a value equal to a limit passes.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: Either Image and the required Pillow exception access must be added to IMPORTS, or the requirement must not require unavailable Pillow symbols.

open_points.subject: prepare_photo behavior
open_points.text: prepare_photo: [BEHAVIOR] MUST make the image of the first frame by exactly the operations of the first rule of A2 in their order: ImageOps.exif_transpose, Image.convert to RGBA with no colour management, Image.thumbnail with a box of the imported PHOTO_MAX_SIDE constant on each side and Image.Resampling.LANCZOS, a paste with its own alpha as the mask onto a new RGB image of the same size filled with the imported PHOTO_BACKGROUND constant, and Image.save as JPEG with quality the imported PHOTO_QUALITY constant, optimize the imported PHOTO_OPTIMIZE constant, progressive the imported PHOTO_PROGRESSIVE constant and subsampling the imported PHOTO_SUBSAMPLING constant, and no EXIF, colour profile or other metadata; it MUST return a PreparedPhoto of those bytes and of the moment and date source _photo_moment gives for the opened source image, modified and the ZoneInfo of timezone_name.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: Either Image and ImageOps must be added to IMPORTS with allowed Pillow imports, or this requirement must stop requiring those unavailable symbols.

open_points.subject: _camera_offset
open_points.text: _camera_offset: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return the datetime.timezone of the offset only when it is a string of a plus or minus sign, two digits of hours not above the imported CAMERA_OFFSET_MAX_HOURS constant, a colon and two digits of a clock minute, and nothing else, and MUST return None for any other value.
